scope: Read-only exact integer PCM channel algebra on already retained EN03 stereo windows; no resampling, preprocessing, playback, model, energy heuristic or channel attribution.
algorithm: Interpret retained bytes as little-endian signed PCM16 interleaved stereo per admitted 44100Hz headers.
Count exact per-sample equality and negation.
Search integer sample lags -8..8 using absolute normalized cross-correlation.
At the best lag, fit unconstrained affine y=gain*x+offset only as a descriptive test; no transformation is applied.
verdict: No exact constant rational gain/sign or integer-delay identity was found. The channels remain source-distinct and speaker/channel authority unknown; retain both and preserve structural gate failure. Correlation is descriptive evidence only and does not authorize downmix or selection.
